title: The slide whistle and Black Benny
summary: Who played slide whistle, Howard's own use of it, and Black Benny's drumming.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: I see. Who played the slide whistle around here? That little Frisco whistle? Played a slide? Slide whistle? You know one of those whistles you love? Frisco whistle?
Well we called him Chani Bebe, used to play with Celeste. I used to play it too, that slide whistle like that.
What was your feature on? What kind of?
Well it seems to be like, yeah, it was pretty good.
I wonder why that died out, you know? I wouldn't know. What's funny. It's funny. He used to do that all the time, the bands.
That's right, Black Benny used to play with Chris too. You heard of Black Benny. He was a right hand man.

And he played? He was a good drummer. And he played, did he play the slide whistle too? I don't remember him playing the slide whistle. But he played with Chris, yeah. Did you ever work with Black Benny?
No, I didn't work with Chani Bebe.
I thought he'd be in the street or something.
No, no. I think before I got started, he passed.
